name: Amamiya Imari
source:
Director of the Amamiya Dental Clinic. She has been taking care of the protagonist's dental maintenance regularly for about a year now. At first glance, she appears to be a calm, soothing woman, but she loves cute boys and never leaves the protagonist in charge of anyone else. She has a secret ambition to monopolize everything about him one day.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1139363]Getchu[/url]]
